conclusion: Preliminary, seed-7-only result on clean labels (outlier_fraction 0.0): OLS linear regression achieved lower MSE (0.17046895861013783) than the matched training-mean baseline (12.888358499556563). This is a single-seed, single-metric preliminary report and does not establish general scientific value.
limitations: Only seed 7 was run; seeds 19 and 31 from the full budget were not executed.
Only mse was computed; mae and median_absolute_error were not executed.
Single seed and single metric provide no variance or robustness estimate.
No statistical test or confidence interval was computed.
Results are limited to the clean-label (outlier_fraction 0.0) configuration and this task version.
No claim of general scientific value is made.
